name: Is (Ys)

attributes.attribute: an alternate name for the Breton city of Ys
the Breton city also called Ker-Ys and the City of Ys

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Is is an alternate name for the Breton city of Ys. It also appears as Ker-Ys and as the City of Ys. For the legend of the sunken city, see Ys.

okr.objective: Document the alternate name Is for the city of Ys.
key_results: Record Is as an alternate name for Ys.
Note the forms Ker-Ys and City of Ys.
Point the reader to the legend under Ys.
evidence: Monaghan, P. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore (2008): Is entry.
